title: Artificial Intelligence, Deepfake, and Fabricated Content: The Shield of Critical Thinking
summary: Deepfake, AI-generated images, and fake news—these can no longer be distinguished by sight alone. The rule is: (1) Is the source official/trusted? (2) Is there another independent source confirming it? (3) Does it provoke anger/fear/urgency? (Three signs of deception). Tools: reverse image search, video verification tools, and the platform’s official website.
try_this: This week: Choose a suspicious video or image—use reverse image search together, and look for the original source. Discuss: How did you uncover the fabrication?
reflection_prompts: Has your child become more cautious about sharing?
